Subject: Contract and kickoff
Date: Thursday 15 October 2026
From: Dom Selvon <dom@valliance.ai>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@bramleyfoods.example.test>

Sofia,

Once the signed contract you promised for this week arrives, I will circulate the kickoff agenda within two working days.

Nothing else outstanding from my side.

Best,
Dom
